title: Pets and Assistance Animals: Community Rules & Site Care Clause
content:
Pets kept on a home site are governed by the following Community Rules & Site Care clause.

## Clause

1. Every pet must be registered within the plan's pet registration period, in calendar days, of joining the household. A household may keep no more than the plan's pet limit, and a dog whose adult weight exceeds the plan's weight limit may not be kept.
2. Registrations and removals are made only while the plan record is enrolled or its plan services are suspended, as its status shows in the system's records.
3. The former provision that each registered pet is charged the plan's annual registration fee for each registration year is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for registration-year fees. The remainder of that provision stands: the fee is charged on the registration date in a pet's first year and on January 1 in later years, and it is never prorated and never refunded when the pet leaves.
4. Service animals and assistance animals documented under fair-housing rules are registered without any fee, do not count toward the pet limit and are not subject to the weight limit. A pet fee charged on such an animal is waived in full, the basis of the waiver being that the animal is an assistance animal.

## Registrations by plan record status

| Status of the plan record | Registration or removal |
|---|---|
| enrolled | made |
| plan services suspended | made |
| ended | not made |

## Hypothetical cases

- A dog first registered on 20 June 2025 carries a fee dated 20 June 2025 for 2025, and its fee for 2026 is dated January 1, 2026.
- A cat whose 2026 fee was charged on January 1 and who leaves the household in March carries no refund of that fee.
- A household keeping the most pets the plan allows may also keep a documented assistance animal; the animal carries no fee and is not counted toward the limit.
- A registration-year fee found on a documented assistance animal is waived in full.

superseded_clauses: Each registered pet is charged pet_registration_fee_annual for each registration year (pet_registration_year_basis)
